calls.statement:
WITH store_period_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.vat_rate,
    f.gross_amount - f.net_amount AS vat_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
store_period_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    r.vat_rate,
    -(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) AS vat_amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT vat_rate, vat_amount FROM store_period_sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT vat_rate, vat_amount FROM store_period_returns
)
SELECT 
  CAST(ROUND(vat_rate * 100, 1) AS VARCHAR) AS vat_rate_percent,
  ROUND(SUM(vat_amount), 2) AS total_vat_charged
FROM combined
GROUP BY vat_rate
ORDER BY vat_rate DESC
